name: Funnel
summary: Pipeline / process funnel as flat stage bars (centred or left-aligned) with conversion % between stages and optional value / % of first columns.
summary_zh: 以扁平条形表示各阶段的管道 / 流程漏斗（居中或左对齐），阶段之间标注转化率，右侧可附金额与占首阶段比例列。
description_zh: 每行数据是一个阶段（按数据顺序自上而下），条形宽度与该阶段数量成正比，相邻阶段之间的浅色连接带标注转化率（相对上一阶段，或相对首阶段）。左侧为阶段名称，右侧可附加第二指标（如管道金额）和“占首阶段比例”两列，形成图表与表格结合的投行风格版式。适合销售管道、交易流程（接触 → 签署保密协议 → 非约束性报价 → 约束性报价 → 签约）、客户转化、招聘流程等 3–8 个阶段的单调递减数据；点击阶段可交叉筛选。
best_for: Commercial pipeline: leads → qualified → proposal → negotiation → won
M&A process funnel: buyers contacted → NDAs → IOIs → final bids
avoid_when: Stages that are not sequential subsets
Comparing several funnels side by side (use a grouped bar chart)

secondary.desc: Second measure shown in a right-hand column and the tooltip (e.g. pipeline value)

conversion.desc: Conversion % in the connector below each stage: previous | first | false

columns.desc: Right-hand columns (secondary value, % of top) with headers

colorBy.desc: stage: ordinal ramp (dark → light) down the funnel | single: accent

highlight.desc: Stage name(s) drawn in accent2 (e.g. 'Closed won')

barRatio.desc: Bar thickness as a share of the row (the rest is the connector)

labels.desc: Value labels on the bars (inside when they fit)

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field's format

secondaryFormat.desc: Secondary column format; defaults to its field's format

crossFilter.desc: Click a stage to cross-filter other blocks

interactions: Hover a stage: value, secondary value, conversion vs. previous and vs. first stage
Click a stage to cross-filter (others dim)
Animated bar / connector transitions when filters change
